elains_paint_tins.name: Elain's Paint Tins
elains_paint_tins.text: Once per battle, the first time you fall below half HP: heal 5 and draw 2.
elains_paint_tins.flavor: Three small tins, red, yellow and blue: the only gift Elain ever gave her.

snare_wire.name: Silverspring Snare Wire
snare_wire.text: At the start of each battle, gain 1 Evade.
snare_wire.flavor: Good wire, carefully coiled. Rabbits make their warrens south of the big bend in Silverspring Creek.

source.note: Silverspring Creek is named in Feyre's parting instructions to her father. The wire itself is a game invention.

iron_bracelet.name: Iron Bracelet
iron_bracelet.text: Take 1 less damage from each hit by a Fae enemy.
iron_bracelet.flavor: 'This is what you should be wearing. Not some silver bells to attract those faerie monsters.' (Nesta)
